resources.string: Hear any post read aloud with one tap

Shows a floating button over Facebook and X. Tap it and the app reads the post on screen aloud, and can translate English into Arabic. No text is stored, and nothing is sent to any server unless you turn on Gemini features (then the text or a screenshot is sent to Google for processing).
Open Facebook or X and the floating button will appear.
Turn on “Listen — post reader” in Accessibility settings. If you see “Restricted setting”: open App info → ⋮ menu → “Allow restricted settings”.

1. Open Facebook or X.
2. Line the post up with the floating button (or drag the button next to it).
3. Tap the button once to start reading, and tap again to stop.
4. Long-press the button for the tools menu: read text in an image, translate the screen, summarize, suggest a reply, voice dictation, and the English→Arabic translation switch.

Needs a free key from Google: open the key page with your Google account → Create API key → copy it and paste it here. The key is stored only on your device. When this is on, the post text is sent to Google’s servers to turn it into speech. If you’re offline or the free quota runs out, the app reads with the device voice.
